title: Broomstick PvP
description: Wonderful PvP experience, who needs swords when you have a broomstick ?!
body:
Broomstick PvP 1.21.11

Ever got bored of using the same old swords all the time? Yeah… same.

So I made this resource pack where instead of a sword, you’re running around with a broomstick 🧹

Nothing crazy gameplay wise it’s still a sword but visually it just feels way more fun (and kinda dumb in a good way). There’s just something funny about smacking mobs with a broom like you’re cleaning up the world one hit at a time. If you want something simple, a bit different, and not too serious, this is for you.

This resource pack replaces the default sword with a broomstick. It keeps the original mechanics of the sword but changes the appearance to a broom for a more fun and unique experience. Perfect for players who want a simple visual change and enjoy a bit of humor while playing.
